notes.title: We're Going Early Access (Don't Worry)
notes.content:
Yo, buttlicks!

So, after much thought, we've decided it best to go Early Access with Teenage Wasteland, aaaaand I'm gonna explain why! Quickly!

So, Teenage Wasteland is a huge game, with loads of side quests, activities, characters, blah, blah, blah. We really want people to get their hands on the game as soon as possible, and we want people to give feedback as the game's being developed, so we can make it the most rad thing it can possibly be!

We're planning on releasing updates location-by-location - TW is split up into 4 main hub areas (the north, south, east and west sides of town) and we want to release major updates in correlation to the completion of these areas! So, currently, we're working on getting the north side of town playable, with a multitude of quests, areas, activities, a brand new companion, new cliques, etc. Once we believe it's worthy enough of release, we'll... Yeah, we'll release it!

With each major update to the game (each being about 8 or so months apart) we'll be adding EVEN more stuff to previously released areas, like quests and perks and locations and stuff! We'll be releasing these updates until the main game and story are complete, and worthy of being labelled as a "full release"!

The main story will not be shown within any of these Early Access updates, nor will certain areas of the game, as we want to save that stuff for the full release, along with other minor and major additions! In terms of pricing, don't worry, the game will be priced fairly - we don't aim to rip people off, heh. Even the first major update we release will be filled with enough content to last for multiple hours!

So... Yeah! Any questions, just ask! There'll be more updates and stuff to come!

- Cyberwaste

notes.title: The First of Many Updates/Sneak Peek at the Goths!
notes.content:
'Sup, nerds! ːsteamhappyː

Welcome to the first update for "Teenage Wasteland": the greatest teen-based RPG set in the early 2000's during a summer vacation with inspiration from games like Fallout: New Vegas and Bully, ever!

As we all know, reading is boring, so I'm gonna make this quick - I'd hate to take time away from your SUPER busy schedule, and all...

So! First thing's first: development on the full game is going VERY well! Since releasing the demo and making the game's page public a couple months ago, we've been hard at work making new sprites, backgrounds, side missions, perks, skills, blah, blah, blah. We'll be regularly sharing our work here on Steam, with screenshots and gifs and updates and stuff!

On top of that, we've also figured out how we're going to be releasing the game, and how long we plan on it taking, as well! Another update will be released that covers our "Roadmap to Release" in more
detail, if you care about that kinda thing. Suffice to say, we should hopefully have something [b]NEW[/b] for everyone to play """soon"""... ish.

Aaaaaaanyway, stay tuned for more updates in the future - sprites, backgrounds, gifs, quests, general crap - so much fun!

Oh, and here's a little look at the those freaky, moody, punky, weirdo goths! Peace!

- Cyberwaste (Writer, Producer, Director, Figurehead)
